parameters.name: JobId
parameters.description: The ID of the inventory task.

parameters.name: Query
parameters.description: The search keyword used for fuzzy matching of knowledge content.

parameters.name: ShowType
parameters.description: The knowledge display type filter, such as TABLE, COLUMN, SQL, SEG, LINEAGE, or TERM.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description:
The field by which to sort the results. Valid values:

- confidence
- entityId

Default value: confidence.

parameters.name: SortOrder
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

- asc: ascending order.
- desc: descending order.

Default value: desc.
